title: LibrarianEnchantmentLimiter
description: This plugin replaces librarian enchanted book trades with level 1 books that cost a random amount of a configurable item plus 1 book.
body:
Tired of overpowered villager trades ruining your server's balance?
Librarian Enchantment Limiter gives you full control over enchanted book trades from librarian villagers.

🔧 Features:
🧙 All librarian enchanted books are reduced to level 1 only

💰 Trades use a random amount (1–40) of a customizable currency item (not just emeralds!)

📖 Trades always require 1 book in addition to the currency

⚙️ Fully configurable via config.yml for seamless server integration

✅ Easy to use — just drop it in your plugins folder and customize your config!

Perfect for survival, RPG, or economy-based servers where balance matters.
